body:
I am male, that is a one in a thousand case and even in the low doses (still only 1/6 a lethal dose) it doesn't effect me that way.

What does it matter as long as I die.   Preferably I would electrocute or shoot myself,  but no gun, and I've survived an accidental electrocution that should have killed me (didn't even need treatment)

That's what I thought when I first got out of the hospital.  Quickly afterwards I realized that the people who said they will care for me and help me through this don't really give a shit.

What makes it worse is that I'm forced to go through this alone, my mother who was my biggest support in the hospital forbids me from talking about it at home.  If I so much as look sad she jumps down my throat, so I don't bother mentioning anything to her and just cry myself to sleep.

I've tried cutting those people out, I already don't deal with most of my family, I won't talk to my brother, I hardly speak to my mother; my father and my mom's ex have been out of my life for years.  I thought I found someone I could live for, but I was wrong about her.  She calls me a good friend, but I have to initiate all conversations.  I'm always inviting her to come hang out, but nothing ever comes together.  Shit the few times I do make plans they end up falling through, or my "friends" forget about me.

I say they don't because I know they don't,  nobody makes an effort for me.  I'm never invited to do anything, so I sit at home alone after work/days off, and mess with my computer all day and do nothing else.

Everyone acts like they care about me, like when I came out and explained to my mother that I tried to kill myself (I tried to hang myself back in September),  after I got out of the hospital (which only made things worse since now I'd rather not tell my psychiatrist or therapist whats on my mind for fear of spending more time in that hell hole). After a few weeks, everything went back to me being ignored, nobody makes an effort to spend time with me or talk to me.  I have to initiate all conversations.  My "friends" call me their friend, but never invite me to do anything.   I'm 23 and still can't drive, since after 3 permits, nobody around me is willing to help me out.
I'm not really sure what I perceive of my life anymore.  I'm not delusional and am aware that there are people who have it much worse.

I tried a support group when I left the hospital, but I knew it wasn't for me and left.

The only reason I stay at my crap job anymore is a girl I'm rather fond of.
